context.dating_note: Start c.275 CE = earliest dated Blemmyes activity in GHA II ch.7 (Probus 276–282). The Blemmyes=Beja equation is customary, NOT proven (GHA II ch.10); GHA II ch.11 says earlier Meroitic-era Majai/Reheres 'could have been' Beja ancestors, so earlier origins are possible. Ongoing people, not a polity.
